note: a huge heavy ball that rolls and bounces off the karts; you steer it by pushing and bumping it, never carry it

text: The ball changes sides about every half second, far quicker than the 4 seconds the check asks for. Should I (A) let a kart briefly hold the ball on its nose until it is bumped off, (B) give the side that last struck the ball a short, visible window in which rivals' light touches can't move it, or (C) keep the ball fully loose and have the possession target dropped?
C. Keep the ball fully loose, that is what I chose: nobody holds it, it rolls off every touch. Drop the 4-second possession target; a fast back-and-forth ball is fine in bumper football.
